You've entered a kitchen.

You see an opened fridge. The fridge contains a block of cheese and a raw pork chop. Look over there! an oven. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a table. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Hopefully, this discovery doesn't ruin your TextWorld experience! You can make out a counter. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The counter is vast. On the counter you can make out a raw yellow potato, a yellow bell pepper and a cookbook. Classic TextWorld. You can see a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing hasn't got anything on it.



There is a knife, a white onion, a red hot pepper, a red onion, a raw purple potato, a red apple and a raw red potato on the floor.
